name: vscode-emulator-run
description: Thin client: connects to a remote gateway server that owns the Flutter SDK, adb, xcodebuild and the devices. F5 in an empty workspace prompts you to pick a remote project + device, tells the remote to run `flutter run`, and opens a streaming window locally. The developer machine never needs Flutter, adb, Xcode, or Android SDK.

commands.title: Emulator Stream: Run on remote device

emulatorStreamRun.server.description: WebSocket URL of the remote gateway server. This is the ONLY host address the extension needs — everything else (Flutter SDK, adb, xcodebuild, the devices, the projects) lives on that machine. Prefer 127.0.0.1 over localhost on the loopback: Node 18+ resolves 'localhost' to IPv6 first, which fails against IPv4-only servers.

emulatorStreamRun.desktopAppPath.description: Advanced: absolute path to the EmulatorDesktopApp binary. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension (recommended).

emulatorStreamRun.openStreamWindow.description: Launch the local streaming window once the remote Flutter app reports started. Turn off to only orchestrate `flutter run` without displaying the stream.

emulatorStreamRun.stopGracePeriodMs.description: How long to wait for the remote Flutter process to exit gracefully after sending 'q' before escalating to SIGTERM.

server.description: WebSocket URL of the remote gateway server (overrides emulatorStreamRun.server).

device.description: Pin a specific remote device id. Omit for an interactive Quick Pick.

projectId.description: Pin a specific remote project id (from flutter-projects.json on the server). Omit for an interactive Quick Pick.

flavor.description: Pin a specific flavor name (from the project's flavors list on the server). Omit for an interactive Quick Pick.

flutterArgs.description: Extra CLI args appended to the remote `flutter run` (e.g. ["--dart-define=FOO=bar"]).

openStreamWindow.description: Open the local streaming window when the remote app reports started.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pick project + device
configurationSnippets.description: Prompts a remote-project, flavor and device Quick Pick, tells the server to run Flutter, opens the streaming window locally.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pin remote project + flavor
configurationSnippets.description: Skip the project + flavor pickers by pinning them.

configurationSnippets.label: Emulator Stream: pin everything
configurationSnippets.description: Fully non-interactive — pin project, flavor and device id.
